title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta20

## MQTT reliability hardening

This beta is based on two Home Assistant field logs plus the October 2026
upstream NavimowHA 1.1.1 fixes.

### Recover a genuinely stale MQTT transport

The existing pose watchdog correctly re-subscribed the location topic after the
pose stream became stale, but the full client rebuild path was never reached.

Field logs showed the consequence clearly:

- recovery started at about 26 seconds of pose staleness;
- the integration kept periodically re-subscribing;
- the same stale age later exceeded 2,700 seconds without a transport rebuild.

beta20 now separates the two failure modes:

- **pose-only stale:** if other current-device MQTT traffic is still arriving,
  preserve the MQTT client, periodically re-subscribe to location and keep the
  private-cloud position fallback;
- **transport stale/disconnected:** if the SDK is disconnected or all
  current-device MQTT traffic has been absent for 180 seconds, escalate to the
  existing in-place SDK client rebuild path.

Repeated pose-only recovery attempts are debug-level after the first warning,
and warnings now include the masked mower serial so multi-mower logs identify
which bridge is degraded.

### MQTT keepalive: 120 seconds

Navimower previously kept the SDK default used by the older official
integration: 2400 seconds.

The official NavimowHA project has now moved to a 120-second MQTT keepalive to
detect half-open broker connections sooner. beta20 follows that upstream value.

### Multi-mower startup import lock

A four-mower Home Assistant restart exposed a CPython module-lock deadlock while
multiple config entries imported the `mower_sdk` package concurrently in
executor threads.

The import still stays off Home Assistant's event loop, but the one-time
`mower_sdk` package import is now serialized across Navimower entries. This
keeps the non-blocking startup design while removing the concurrent import-lock
race.

### MQTT user-info circuit-breaker backoff

Upstream NavimowHA 1.1.1 also treats failures of
`/openapi/mqtt/userInfo/get/v2` as non-fatal because repeated setup retries can
keep the vendor circuit breaker open.

Navimower already keeps private-cloud data and entities available when official
MQTT startup fails, so beta20 does not persist extra MQTT credentials. Instead,
a non-auth MQTT user-info failure raises the bridge retry delay to 10 minutes.
Other transient startup failures retain the normal short exponential retry.

A failed rebuild that reaches the same user-info circuit breaker also honors
that 10-minute backoff.

### Upstream stale-cache finding

NavimowHA 1.1.1 prevents the SDK's unchanged cached MQTT state from replacing a
newer HTTP fallback result. Navimower does not use `get_cached_state()` or
`get_cached_attributes()` in its coordinator. Private-cloud refresh is merged
with the current runtime MQTT state after the blocking fetch, so no equivalent
runtime patch is required here; beta20 adds a regression contract to preserve
that ordering.

No Map Card update is required.
